I actually don't believe it is discrimination on religious grounds.  Religion is not forcing him to spread dangerous hate speech. If one is a prick because they believe their religion justifies it. They are still a prick in the eyes of everyone else.

Now if he was blocked from playing simply because he is Christian, Muslim, Jew, Jedi e.t.c.  that would be discrimination.

I'm glad we can agree Folau is an oblivious dunce. But it wouldn't be blocking him for being Pentecostal, it would be blocking him for bringing the game and his employer into disrepute. The fact that he did this because he was Pentecostal is irrelevant. And if that means people who share his denomination are more likely to be banned, its still because of their actions, not their religion.
Nice try Jeremy. See you at work
Haha, there is probably some truth to this. Poor repressed Izzy and his bad thoughts. If only he knew it was OK to have these feelings.

I can certainly make the separation that you can't in good faith and that's where we see things different. :)

The way I see it, It makes no difference if his actions are in genuine adherence to his beliefs, in fact I am sure they are. The fact is his actions are harmful and a cause for dismissal from his employer because he has bought embarrassment and much exasperation to them. Not to mention the potential financial ramifications.

So sure, he can enjoy the right to have and express his beliefs. But he can do that from the unemployment queue (figure of speech). 

And I never made any reference to him being a role model. Although that is part of the gig whether they want it to be or not. He is certainly an oblivious dunce.

Bi here. Was very offended. He needed to go. And I don't care if he now considers himself a martyr. Its not about his feelings or beliefs. Its about making rugby and broadly the world a little safer for us by not tolerating this divisive vitriol. There was a time in my life that reading his comments could have been very bad for me. Today I am in a better place but I understand how dangerous it can be for a young gay person struggling with their identity. Particularly a young gay Aussie rugby fan.
100% agree mate.
